title: Calibration Goodwill on Calibration Workmanship Warranty Diagnostic Charges: Desk Card
content:
**Subject.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, calibration goodwill is a reduction granted on a calibration diagnostic charge of a Calibration Workmanship Warranty when the customer asks for one; it is booked against the calibration diagnostic charge booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before, and it never exceeds the plan's goodwill authority per charge, a request for more being declined at the desk.

**Prerequisite clause.** Calibration goodwill is figured only after the calibration diagnostic charge owed on the not-covered calibration finding stands on the coverage's account.

In other words, while the calibration diagnostic charge owed on the not-covered calibration finding does not yet stand on the coverage's account, there is no calibration goodwill to figure.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Arises | When the customer asks for a goodwill reduction on a calibration diagnostic charge of a Calibration Workmanship Warranty |
| Booked against | The calibration diagnostic charge booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before |
| Ceiling | Never more than the plan's goodwill authority per charge; a request for more is declined at the desk |
| Timing | Figured only after the calibration diagnostic charge owed on the not-covered calibration finding stands on the coverage's account |

## The action: `grant_calibration_goodwill_f9a2e5bf`

**Capability.** Grants a goodwill reduction on one calibration diagnostic charge of a Calibration Workmanship Warranty coverage. One call books a goodwill waiver, dated today, against the named charge on the coverage's customer charges account, lowering what the customer owes on that charge by the amount given; the coverage's money history then shows a goodwill waiver naming the charge.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_calibration_goodwill_f9a2e5bf` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_coverage_id` | Reference number of the Calibration Workmanship Warranty coverage that carries the charge, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup | text reference number |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the diagnostic charge entry being reduced, as shown in the coverage's money history or on the receipt of the charge's booking | text reference number |
| `amount_usd` | The goodwill reduction | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "waived", `warranty_entry_id` (the new waiver entry's reference number), `source_entry_id` (the charge reduced), `waiver_reason` (always "goodwill"), `amount_usd` (2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD). The receipt's reference number confirms the reduction is booked.
